svg.title: Prisma ORM v7.4: Query Caching, Partial Indexes, and Major Performance Improvements
svg.desc: A release-notes card for Prisma ORM 7.4 listing three named features: query caching with per-query compilation cost falling from 0.1-1ms to 1-10 microseconds, partial indexes behind a preview feature flag, and a typical cache hit rate near 100 percent. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand, prism cyan accent.
